concepts.name: • The Ethiopian Army Was To Be Trained B
concepts.simple_definition: History Grade 10 Student Textbook 146 These include the following: • the Ethiopian army was to be trained by the British military mission; • the British minister enjoyed a privilege over the other diplomatic representatives in Ethiopia ; • British advisors were assigned to each government ministry office; • the British military could use former Italian state property without payment; and • the British were also to remain in control of the region termed as the Haud and the reserved area along the boundary with the British Somaliland and the rest of the Ogaden
concepts.deep_explanation: • The high-power radio transmitting station, the telephone system and the railway were to remain under the British control
